info.about: Toki Tori is a puzzle-platform video game developed by Two Tribes and published by Capcom for the Game Boy Color. The game follows a young chick, Toki Tori, and his quest to rescue his younger siblings, still in their eggs.
info.why: Capcom published it in North America in September 2001, after the Game Boy Advance had launched, so the cartridge run was short; every later release of the game was digital only.
